comparison.objective: Uncap and spike an IV bag, then prime its drip chamber; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a sliding bag, remove cap, align/insert a spike and squeeze a chamber versus hex-key use, collar tuning, locking and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Requires spike lock, one or two valid squeezes, simulated one-third to two-thirds fill and arm withdrawal; candidate requires physical energy dissipation within stroke and rebound limits.
comparison.reason: Insertion is shared only at a generic level; mechanisms, force sequence and validated outcome are different.
